concept.title: Router vs Access Point
concept.shortdesc: Routers and access points perform different functions in a home network. Understanding their roles helps users deploy network equipment more effectively.

section.title: Overview
section.p: A router and a Wi Fi access point both support network connectivity, but they perform different functions.

section.title: Router
section.p: The connects the home network to the Internet and manages communication between devices.

section.title: Access Point
section.p: The provides wireless connectivity for client devices.
An access point depends on a router for access to network and Internet services.

section.title: Advanced Comparison
section.p: A router performs network routing functions between networks.
An access point bridges wireless devices to the wired network.
